chat.welcomeMessage:
Nnọọ! 👋 Abụ m onye enyemaka gị n'ọrụ ugbo.

M nwere ike inyere gị aka na:
• Ihe ubi, akwụkwọ nri, mkpụrụ osisi, na okooko osisi
• Ịzụ anụ ụlọ, ọkụkọ, na azụ
• Nchịkwa ahụhụ na ọrịa
• Ndụmọdụ ihu igwe na ahịa

Olee otú m ga-esi nyere gị aka taa?

agrivision.name: AgriVision
agrivision.tagline: Ihe nchoputa ọrịa osisi site n'AKỌ
agrivision.description: Lelee foto osisi iji chọpụta ọrịa, ahụhụ na ụkọ nri. Nweta nchoputa ngwa ngwa na ndụmọdụ ọgwụgwọ na mgbochi.

isdaSoil.name: ISDA Soil
isdaSoil.tagline: Njirimara ala na nyocha nri maka Africa
isdaSoil.description: Nweta ozi ala zuru ezu gụnyere pH, nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, na nri ndị ọzọ. Ọ na-ekpuchi Africa niile na mkpebi mita 30.

accuweather.name: AccuWeather
accuweather.tagline: Ọnọdụ ihu igwe ugbu a na amụma ihu igwe n'ụwa niile
accuweather.description: Nweta ozi ihu igwe ozugbo gụnyere okpomọkụ, iru mmiri, ọsọ ifufe, na mmiri ozuzo. Amụma dị maka ụbọchị iri na ise.

gapWeather.name: GAP Weather
gapWeather.tagline: Amụma ihu igwe ugbo maka Kenya
gapWeather.description: Amụma ihu igwe pụrụ iche maka ọrụ ugbo na Kenya. Gụnyere amụma evapotranspiration, radieshon anyanwụ, na mmiri ozuzo e mere maka mkpebi ọrụ ugbo.

edacap.name: EDACaP Climate
edacap.tagline: Amụma ihu igwe oge maka Ethiopia
edacap.description: Nlele ihu igwe oge gụnyere amụma okpomọkụ na mmiri ozuzo. Na-enyere ndị ọrụ ugbo aka ịhazi oge ịkụ mkpụrụ na owuwe ihe ubi.

weatherapi.name: WeatherAPI
weatherapi.tagline: Ozi ihu igwe maka ebe niile n'ụwa
weatherapi.description: Ọrụ ozi ihu igwe zuru oke na-enye ọnọdụ ugbu a na amụma maka ebe niile n'ụwa.

tomorrowIo.name: Tomorrow.io
tomorrowIo.description: Ngosipụta ọgụgụ ihu igwe dị elu nwere amụma dị elu na ike amụma ugbu a.

feedFormulation.name: Nkwadebe Nri Anụ
feedFormulation.tagline: Ngụkọ nri kachasị mma maka ehi mmiri ara ehi
feedFormulation.description: Gụọ ngwakọta nri kachasị mma maka ehi mmiri ara ehi gị. Na-eburu n'uche ebumnuche mmiri ara ehi, ibu anụ ahụ, na nri dị n'ógbè.

nextgen.name: NextGen Fatịlaịza
nextgen.tagline: Ndụmọdụ fatịlaịza kpọmkwem ebe maka Ethiopia
nextgen.description: Nweta ndụmọdụ fatịlaịza ziri ezi dabere n'ebe ị nọ kpọmkwem. Gụnyere ndụmọdụ fatịlaịza organic (compost, vermicompost) na inorganic (Urea, NPS).

decisionTree.name: Osisi Mkpebi Ubi
decisionTree.description: Nweta ndụmọdụ njikwa ihe ubi dabere n'oge uto na ọnọdụ ihu igwe ugbu a. Na-enyere gị aka ime mkpebi oge maka nchịkwa ahụhụ, ịgbara mmiri, na owuwe ihe ubi.

gapAgriculture.name: GAP Agriculture
gapAgriculture.description: Ọrụ ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo n'ozuzu maka njikwa ihe ubi na anụ ụlọ.

plantix.name: Plantix
plantix.tagline: Nchọpụta ọrịa ihe ọkụkụ, nkwado asụsụ iri abụọ na otu
plantix.description: Chọpụta ọrịa ihe ọkụkụ site na foto site na iji AI Plantix.

googleWeather.name: Google Weather
googleWeather.tagline: Ihu igwe ụwa niile, amụma na akụkọ ya gara aga
googleWeather.description: Ama ihu igwe zuru ezu site na Google, nwere amụma ụbọchị iri, amụma awa 240 na akụkọ ihu igwe awa 24 gara aga.
